controls.name: Source compression versus decompression
controls.requirement: Retain both phases and their difference; unloading cannot erase loading results.

controls.name: Foot versus bridge
controls.requirement: Keep fixture and sequence effects separate; no independent-specimen claim from two conditions.

controls.name: Porous versus conventional solid
controls.requirement: Treat as numerical source comparison; do not silently add a physical solid specimen.

controls.name: Hinge thickness and loading mode sweep
controls.requirement: Preserve numerical sweep scope separately from physical 0.2 mm hinges.

controls.name: Nearest fit versus boundary-only prediction
controls.requirement: Prevent interior displacement leakage into boundary inference; report separate residuals.

controls.name: Imaging reference and drift
controls.requirement: Commission stationary/reference target captures and drift limits before trial; counts and tolerances are unknown until approved.

controls.name: Mechanics zero and fixture state
controls.requirement: Commission sensor zero, fixture locks and load/stroke calibration; preserve pre/post records.

controls.name: Tracking and transform robustness
controls.requirement: Qualify reference IDs, masks, pixel-to-world uncertainty and missing-point policy using declared checks; no claimed validation here.

controls.name: Independent samples and repeats
controls.requirement: Freeze independent specimen count, per-condition cycle count, condition order, recovery and stopping; no invented n.

reported_repeats: Main describes a sample and a compression-decompression cycle in each physical condition. It does not establish an independent specimen count, population statistic or replicate allocation.
